definitions.explanation: A person enrolled in a university or college.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{大学生|だいがくせい}です。
{大学生|だいがくせい}の{時|とき}、アルバイトをしていました。
examples.english: When I was a university student, I had a part-time job.

examples.japanese: {大学生|だいがくせい}になったら{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしをしたい。
examples.english: When I become a university student, I want to live alone.

notes:
{大学生|だいがくせい} is a compound: {大学|だいがく} (university) + {生|せい} (student).

RELATED STUDENT TERMS:
- {小学生|しょうがくせい}: elementary student
- {中学生|ちゅうがくせい}: middle school student
- {高校生|こうこうせい}: high school student
- {大学院生|だいがくいんせい}: graduate student
- {留学生|りゅうがくせい}: international student

YEARS IN UNIVERSITY:
- {一年生|いちねんせい}: first-year
- {二年生|にねんせい}: second-year
- {三年生|さんねんせい}: third-year
- {四年生|よねんせい}: fourth-year
